# Chatterbox Turbo

Resemble AI · released 2025-12

ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo (350M English model with a one-step distilled decoder), loaded by ChatterboxTurboTTS in the official chatterbox-tts package. Distinct from Chatterbox and Chatterbox Multilingual.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox-turbo)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

```sh
pip install chatterbox-tts && python -c "import torchaudio as ta; from chatterbox.tts_turbo import ChatterboxTurboTTS; m = ChatterboxTurboTTS.from_pretrained(device='cpu'); ta.save('test-turbo.wav', m.generate('Hi there, Sarah here from MochaFone calling you back [chuckle], have you got one minute to chat about the billing issue?'), m.sr)"
```
